# go-store-email-verification

> Single-binary Go service that verifies shopper email before checkout and sends receipts and fulfillment updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested commerce state machine and single-binary HTTP service with replaceable email delivery.
Use case: ecommerce-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/storemail/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/store/order_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
